    local port="$2"

    if command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        if curl -s -o /dev/null -w '' --connect-timeout "$TIMEOUT" "http://localhost:${port}/" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo -e "  ${GREEN}✔ HEALTHY${NC}  | ${name} (port ${port}) is responding"
            healthy=$((healthy + 1))
            return 0
        fi

        echo -e "  ${GREEN}✔ HEALTHY${NC}  | ${name} (port ${port}) is responding"
        healthy=$((healthy + 1))
        return 0
    fi

    # Fallback: use nc (netcat) if available
    if command -v nc &> /dev/null; then
        if nc -z -w "$TIMEOUT" localhost "$port" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo -e "  ${GREEN}✔ HEALTHY${NC}  | ${name} (port ${port}) is responding"
            healthy=$((healthy + 1))
            return 0
        fi

    echo -e "  ${RED}✘ DOWN${NC}    | ${name} (port ${port}) is NOT responding"
    unhealthy=$((unhealthy + 1))
    return 1
}

# Run health checks
for service in "${SERVICES[@]}"; do
    name="${service%%:*}"
    port="${service##*:}"
    check_port "$name" "$port" || true
done

echo "----------------------------------------"
echo ""

# Summary
echo "Summary:"
echo "  Total services checked: ${total}"
echo -e "  Healthy:                ${GREEN}${healthy}${NC}"
echo -e "  Unhealthy:              ${RED}${unhealthy}${NC}"
echo ""

# Exit with appropriate code
if [ "$unhealthy" -gt 0 ]; then
    echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠  WARNING: ${unhealthy} service(s) not responding!${NC}"
    echo ""
    exit 1
else
    echo -e "${GREEN}✔  All services are healthy.${NC}"
    echo ""
    exit 0
fi
